_comment: GENERATED by app/src/components/chart/supportLoop/assistantPineReference.test.js (WRITE_ASSISTANT_PINE_REFERENCE=1). Do not edit by hand. Each recipe with the paste path's verdict and a real compute on both histories; only `served` recipes are ever shown to the assistant (api/services/pine_authoring.py).

recipes.title: Zigzag by percent
recipes.shows: a state machine kept in `var`: the running extreme, its bar, and the direction; a leg is confirmed when price reverses by the input percent, and ONE line per confirmed leg is drawn from the last confirmed swing to the new one
recipes.source:
//@version=5
indicator("Zigzag", overlay=true, max_lines_count=200)
pct = input.float(8.0, "Reversal %", minval=0.1)
var int dir = 0
var float extreme = na
var int extremeBar = na
var float lastY = na
var int lastX = na
if na(extreme)
    extreme := close
    extremeBar := bar_index
    lastY := close
    lastX := bar_index
if dir >= 0 and high > extreme
    extreme := high
    extremeBar := bar_index
    dir := 1
if dir <= 0 and low < extreme
    extreme := low
    extremeBar := bar_index
    dir := -1
downTurn = dir == 1 and low <= extreme * (1 - pct / 100)
upTurn = dir == -1 and high >= extreme * (1 + pct / 100)
if downTurn or upTurn
    line.new(lastX, lastY, extremeBar, extreme, color=dir == 1 ? color.green : color.red, width=2)
    lastX := extremeBar
    lastY := extreme
    dir := downTurn ? -1 : 1
    extreme := downTurn ? low : high
    extremeBar := bar_index
plot(lastY, "Last confirmed swing", color=color.gray)
recipes.headline: Runs on the chart, with 2 notes

recipes.title: Supply and demand zones
recipes.shows: a zone is a box from a confirmed pivot (known `right` bars late) one ATR deep, extended to the right; boxes are kept in arrays so a zone price closes through is deleted, and the oldest is deleted past the input count
recipes.source:
//@version=5
indicator("Supply and Demand Zones", overlay=true, max_boxes_count=100)
left = input.int(10, "Pivot bars left", minval=1)
right = input.int(10, "Pivot bars right", minval=1)
depth = input.float(1.0, "Zone depth (ATR)", minval=0.1)
keep = input.int(6, "Zones kept each side", minval=1)
atr = ta.atr(14)
ph = ta.pivothigh(high, left, right)
pl = ta.pivotlow(low, left, right)
var box[] supply = array.new_box(0)
var box[] demand = array.new_box(0)
if not na(ph)
    array.push(supply, box.new(bar_index - right, ph, bar_index, ph - depth * atr, extend=extend.right, bgcolor=color.new(color.red, 85), border_color=color.red))
    if array.size(supply) > keep
        oldBox = array.shift(supply)
        box.delete(oldBox)
if not na(pl)
    array.push(demand, box.new(bar_index - right, pl + depth * atr, bar_index, pl, extend=extend.right, bgcolor=color.new(color.green, 85), border_color=color.green))
    if array.size(demand) > keep
        oldBox = array.shift(demand)
        box.delete(oldBox)
if array.size(supply) > 0
    for i = array.size(supply) - 1 to 0
        b = array.get(supply, i)
        if close > box.get_top(b)
            box.delete(b)
            array.remove(supply, i)
if array.size(demand) > 0
    for i = array.size(demand) - 1 to 0
        b = array.get(demand, i)
        if close < box.get_bottom(b)
            box.delete(b)
            array.remove(demand, i)
plot(array.size(supply) + array.size(demand), "Zones standing", display=display.data_window)
recipes.headline: Runs on the chart, with 2 notes

recipes.title: Volume profile of the last N bars
recipes.shows: drawn once, on the last bar: the range of the last N bars is cut into rows, each bar's volume is added to the row its close falls in, and each row is a box whose length is its share of the largest row; the point of control is PLOTTED so the script has an output besides its drawings
recipes.source:
//@version=5
indicator("Volume Profile", overlay=true, max_boxes_count=100)
n = input.int(60, "Bars", minval=5, maxval=500)
rows = input.int(24, "Rows", minval=4, maxval=60)
width = input.int(30, "Longest row (bars)", minval=5, maxval=200)
hi = ta.highest(high, n)
lo = ta.lowest(low, n)
var box[] drawn = array.new_box(0)
var float poc = na
if barstate.islast and hi > lo
    while array.size(drawn) > 0
        oldBox = array.pop(drawn)
        box.delete(oldBox)
    step = (hi - lo) / rows
    vols = array.new_float(rows, 0.0)
    for i = 0 to n - 1
        r = math.min(rows - 1, math.floor((close[i] - lo) / step))
        array.set(vols, r, array.get(vols, r) + volume[i])
    top = array.max(vols)
    for r = 0 to rows - 1
        v = array.get(vols, r)
        len = math.max(1, math.round(v / top * width))
        isPoc = v == top
        if isPoc
            poc := lo + (r + 0.5) * step
        array.push(drawn, box.new(bar_index - n, lo + (r + 1) * step, bar_index - n + len, lo + r * step, bgcolor=color.new(isPoc ? color.orange : color.blue, 60), border_color=color.new(color.blue, 100)))
plot(poc, "Point of control", color=color.orange, style=plot.style_linebr)

recipes.title: Session VWAP with its own deviation bands
recipes.shows: VWAP's own bands, worked by hand because `ta.vwap`'s three-value form is not served: three running sums restart on each new day (`var`, reset when the day changes), VWAP is the volume-weighted mean of hlc3 and the band is the volume-weighted standard deviation of hlc3 around it; no `fill` (a script that carries values in `var` is run bar by bar, and that run does not draw a fill between plots yet)
recipes.source:
//@version=5
indicator("VWAP with Deviation Bands", overlay=true)
m1 = input.float(1.0, "Inner band (deviations)", minval=0.1)
m2 = input.float(2.0, "Outer band (deviations)", minval=0.1)
src = hlc3
newDay = ta.change(dayofmonth) != 0
var float sumV = 0.0
var float sumPV = 0.0
var float sumP2V = 0.0
if newDay
    sumV := 0.0
    sumPV := 0.0
    sumP2V := 0.0
sumV += volume
sumPV += src * volume
sumP2V += src * src * volume
vwap = sumV > 0 ? sumPV / sumV : na
dev = sumV > 0 ? math.sqrt(math.max(sumP2V / sumV - vwap * vwap, 0)) : na
plot(vwap, "VWAP", color=color.orange, width=2)
plot(vwap + m1 * dev, "Upper 1", color=color.gray)
plot(vwap - m1 * dev, "Lower 1", color=color.gray)
plot(vwap + m2 * dev, "Upper 2", color=color.silver)
plot(vwap - m2 * dev, "Lower 2", color=color.silver)

recipes.title: Divergence between price and RSI, pivot to pivot
recipes.shows: a divergence is read from one confirmed pivot of the oscillator to the one before it (`ta.valuewhen(found, x, 1)`): price makes a lower low while the oscillator makes a higher low; the pivot is known `right` bars late, so the mark is offset back to the pivot's own bar
recipes.source:
//@version=5
indicator("RSI Divergence", overlay=false)
len = input.int(14, "RSI length", minval=2)
left = input.int(5, "Pivot bars left", minval=1)
right = input.int(5, "Pivot bars right", minval=1)
osc = ta.rsi(close, len)
plFound = not na(ta.pivotlow(osc, left, right))
phFound = not na(ta.pivothigh(osc, left, right))
bull = plFound and low[right] < ta.valuewhen(plFound, low[right], 1) and osc[right] > ta.valuewhen(plFound, osc[right], 1)
bear = phFound and high[right] > ta.valuewhen(phFound, high[right], 1) and osc[right] < ta.valuewhen(phFound, osc[right], 1)
plot(osc, "RSI", color=color.purple)
plot(70, "Overbought", color=color.gray)
plot(30, "Oversold", color=color.gray)
plotshape(bull, "Bullish divergence", shape.triangleup, location.bottom, color.green, offset=-right)
plotshape(bear, "Bearish divergence", shape.triangledown, location.top, color.red, offset=-right)
alertcondition(bull, "Bullish divergence", "RSI bullish divergence")
alertcondition(bear, "Bearish divergence", "RSI bearish divergence")

recipes.title: Higher highs and higher lows, labelled
recipes.shows: each confirmed pivot is compared with the pivot of the same kind before it (kept in `var`) and labelled HH, LH, HL or LL at the pivot's own bar; the labels are kept in an ARRAY and the oldest deleted past the input count, so the run owns them and the chart never fills (at most two are added on a bar, so two `if` trim it); the trend state is plotted as 1, -1 or 0 so it can be screened and alerted on, and so is the size of the label list, a value taken from the list the drawings are in
recipes.source:
//@version=5
indicator("Market Structure", overlay=true, max_labels_count=100)
left = input.int(5, "Pivot bars left", minval=1)
right = input.int(5, "Pivot bars right", minval=1)
keep = input.int(40, "Labels kept", minval=2, maxval=100)
ph = ta.pivothigh(high, left, right)
pl = ta.pivotlow(low, left, right)
var float lastHigh = na
var float lastLow = na
var bool higherHigh = false
var bool higherLow = false
var label[] marks = array.new_label(0)
if not na(ph)
    higherHigh := not na(lastHigh) and ph > lastHigh
    if not na(lastHigh)
        array.push(marks, label.new(bar_index - right, ph, higherHigh ? "HH" : "LH", style=label.style_label_down, color=higherHigh ? color.green : color.red, textcolor=color.white, size=size.small))
    lastHigh := ph
if not na(pl)
    higherLow := not na(lastLow) and pl > lastLow
    if not na(lastLow)
        array.push(marks, label.new(bar_index - right, pl, higherLow ? "HL" : "LL", style=label.style_label_up, color=higherLow ? color.green : color.red, textcolor=color.white, size=size.small))
    lastLow := pl
if array.size(marks) > keep
    oldLabel = array.shift(marks)
    label.delete(oldLabel)
if array.size(marks) > keep
    oldLabel = array.shift(marks)
    label.delete(oldLabel)
trend = higherHigh and higherLow ? 1 : not higherHigh and not higherLow and not na(lastHigh) and not na(lastLow) ? -1 : 0
plot(trend, "Structure (1 up, -1 down)", display=display.data_window)
plot(array.size(marks), "Labels on the chart", display=display.data_window)
alertcondition(trend == 1 and trend[1] != 1, "Structure turned up", "Higher high and higher low")

recipes.title: Unfilled gaps as zones
recipes.shows: a gap is a bar whose low is above the high before it (or the reverse) by the input percent; its box is extended right and deleted on the bar that trades back through the far side of it; the number of gaps still open is plotted, a value taken from the lists the boxes are in
recipes.source:
//@version=5
indicator("Unfilled Gaps", overlay=true, max_boxes_count=100)
minPct = input.float(1.0, "Smallest gap %", minval=0.1)
keep = input.int(20, "Gaps kept", minval=1)
var box[] ups = array.new_box(0)
var box[] downs = array.new_box(0)
gapUp = low > high[1] and (low - high[1]) / high[1] * 100 >= minPct
gapDown = high < low[1] and (low[1] - high) / low[1] * 100 >= minPct
if gapUp
    array.push(ups, box.new(bar_index - 1, low, bar_index, high[1], extend=extend.right, bgcolor=color.new(color.green, 85), border_color=color.green))
    if array.size(ups) > keep
        oldBox = array.shift(ups)
        box.delete(oldBox)
if gapDown
    array.push(downs, box.new(bar_index - 1, low[1], bar_index, high, extend=extend.right, bgcolor=color.new(color.red, 85), border_color=color.red))
    if array.size(downs) > keep
        oldBox = array.shift(downs)
        box.delete(oldBox)
if array.size(ups) > 0
    for i = array.size(ups) - 1 to 0
        b = array.get(ups, i)
        if low <= box.get_bottom(b) and not gapUp
            box.delete(b)
            array.remove(ups, i)
if array.size(downs) > 0
    for i = array.size(downs) - 1 to 0
        b = array.get(downs, i)
        if high >= box.get_top(b) and not gapDown
            box.delete(b)
            array.remove(downs, i)
plot(array.size(ups) + array.size(downs), "Open gaps", display=display.data_window)
plotshape(gapUp, "Gap up", shape.triangleup, location.belowbar, color.green, size=size.tiny)
plotshape(gapDown, "Gap down", shape.triangledown, location.abovebar, color.red, size=size.tiny)

recipes.title: Linear regression channel with its own deviation
recipes.shows: the channel's bands are the deviation of price AROUND THE LINE (the root-mean-square residual over the window, by a loop), never a deviation of the close; `ta.linreg(src, n, 0)` minus `ta.linreg(src, n, 1)` is the line's slope per bar; no `fill` (a script with a loop is run bar by bar, and that run does not draw a fill between plots yet)
recipes.source:
//@version=5
indicator("Linear Regression Channel", overlay=true)
n = input.int(100, "Length", minval=5, maxval=500)
mult = input.float(2.0, "Deviations", minval=0.1)
mid = ta.linreg(close, n, 0)
slope = mid - ta.linreg(close, n, 1)
float sq = 0.0
for i = 0 to n - 1
    sq += math.pow(close[i] - (mid - slope * i), 2)
dev = math.sqrt(sq / n)
plot(mid, "Regression line", color=color.blue)
plot(mid + mult * dev, "Upper", color=color.gray)
plot(mid - mult * dev, "Lower", color=color.gray)

recipes.title: Schaff Trend Cycle, two stages
recipes.shows: two stochastic stages, each smoothed with a value CARRIED from the bar before (`var`, updated with `:=`): the first stage is where the MACD sits in its own range, the second where the smoothed first stage sits in its own; a flat range keeps the value before
recipes.source:
//@version=5
indicator("Schaff Trend Cycle", overlay=false)
fast = input.int(23, "Fast EMA", minval=1)
slow = input.int(50, "Slow EMA", minval=2)
cycle = input.int(10, "Cycle", minval=2)
factor = input.float(0.5, "Smoothing factor", minval=0.01, maxval=1)
m = ta.ema(close, fast) - ta.ema(close, slow)
lo1 = ta.lowest(m, cycle)
r1 = ta.highest(m, cycle) - lo1
var float k1 = na
k1 := r1 > 0 ? (m - lo1) / r1 * 100 : nz(k1[1])
var float d1 = na
d1 := na(d1[1]) ? k1 : d1[1] + factor * (k1 - d1[1])
lo2 = ta.lowest(d1, cycle)
r2 = ta.highest(d1, cycle) - lo2
var float k2 = na
k2 := r2 > 0 ? (d1 - lo2) / r2 * 100 : nz(k2[1])
var float stc = na
stc := na(stc[1]) ? k2 : stc[1] + factor * (k2 - stc[1])
plot(stc, "STC", color=color.teal, width=2)
plot(75, "Upper", color=color.gray)
plot(25, "Lower", color=color.gray)

recipes.title: Average return by day of the week
recipes.shows: statistics are worked over a FIXED window of the last N bars, by a loop on the last bar only: a running total kept since the first bar depends on where the chart's history starts, and this engine does not draw that on a chart that does not reach the listing; the table is written once, and the best day's average is PLOTTED so the script has an output besides the table
recipes.source:
//@version=5
indicator("Weekday Returns", overlay=false)
n = input.int(500, "Bars looked back", minval=20, maxval=2000)
r = close / close[1] - 1
names = array.from("Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat")
var table t = table.new(position.top_right, 3, 8)
float best = na
if barstate.islast
    sums = array.new_float(7, 0.0)
    counts = array.new_int(7, 0)
    for i = 0 to n - 1
        if not na(r[i])
            d = dayofweek[i] - 1
            array.set(sums, d, array.get(sums, d) + r[i])
            array.set(counts, d, array.get(counts, d) + 1)
    int bestDay = na
    for d = 0 to 6
        if array.get(counts, d) > 0
            avg = array.get(sums, d) / array.get(counts, d) * 100
            if na(best) or avg > best
                best := avg
                bestDay := d
    table.cell(t, 0, 0, "Day", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.gray)
    table.cell(t, 1, 0, "Avg %", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.gray)
    table.cell(t, 2, 0, "Days", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.gray)
    for d = 0 to 6
        k = array.get(counts, d)
        bg = d == bestDay ? color.new(color.green, 60) : color.new(color.gray, 85)
        table.cell(t, 0, d + 1, array.get(names, d), bgcolor=bg)
        table.cell(t, 1, d + 1, k > 0 ? str.tostring(array.get(sums, d) / k * 100, "#.###") : "-", bgcolor=bg)
        table.cell(t, 2, d + 1, str.tostring(k), bgcolor=bg)
plot(best, "Best day's average return %", color=color.green, style=plot.style_circles)

recipes.title: VWAP anchored to a date the member picks
recipes.shows: the anchor date is three whole-number inputs compared with the bar's own `year`, `month` and `dayofmonth` (an `input.time` default is not held by this engine, so the date is not one setting); two running sums start at the first bar on or after that date, and nothing is drawn before it
recipes.source:
//@version=5
indicator("Anchored VWAP", overlay=true)
y = input.int(2026, "Anchor year", minval=1990, maxval=2100)
mo = input.int(1, "Anchor month", minval=1, maxval=12)
d = input.int(1, "Anchor day", minval=1, maxval=31)
started = year > y or (year == y and (month > mo or (month == mo and dayofmonth >= d)))
src = hlc3
var float sumV = 0.0
var float sumPV = 0.0
if started
    sumV += volume
    sumPV += src * volume
avwap = started and sumV > 0 ? sumPV / sumV : na
plot(avwap, "Anchored VWAP", color=color.orange, width=2)

recipes.title: Opening range of the first minutes
recipes.shows: the range is built while the bar is inside the opening minutes of the day (minutes since the day's first bar, kept in `var`) and held for the rest of the day; it is for intraday charts and says nothing on a daily one
recipes.source:
//@version=5
indicator("Opening Range", overlay=true)
minutes = input.int(30, "Opening minutes", minval=1, maxval=240)
newDay = ta.change(dayofmonth) != 0
var int dayStart = na
var float orHigh = na
var float orLow = na
if newDay
    dayStart := time
    orHigh := high
    orLow := low
inRange = not na(dayStart) and time - dayStart < minutes * 60000
if inRange and not newDay
    orHigh := math.max(orHigh, high)
    orLow := math.min(orLow, low)
show = timeframe.isintraday and not inRange
plot(show ? orHigh : na, "Opening range high", color=color.green, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(show ? orLow : na, "Opening range low", color=color.red, style=plot.style_linebr)
alertcondition(show and ta.crossover(close, orHigh), "Opening range breakout", "Price broke above the opening range")

recipes.title: Fibonacci retracement between the last two swings
recipes.shows: the last confirmed pivot high and pivot low are kept in `var` with their bars; each level's PRICE is worked out on every bar into an array, the lines and labels are redrawn from it on the last bar only (kept in arrays, deleted before they are made again), and the 61.8% level is plotted so it can be alerted on
recipes.source:
//@version=5
indicator("Fibonacci Retracement", overlay=true, max_lines_count=50, max_labels_count=50)
left = input.int(10, "Pivot bars left", minval=1)
right = input.int(10, "Pivot bars right", minval=1)
ph = ta.pivothigh(high, left, right)
pl = ta.pivotlow(low, left, right)
var float swingHigh = na
var int highBar = na
var float swingLow = na
var int lowBar = na
if not na(ph)
    swingHigh := ph
    highBar := bar_index - right
if not na(pl)
    swingLow := pl
    lowBar := bar_index - right
levels = array.from(0.0, 0.236, 0.382, 0.5, 0.618, 0.786, 1.0)
prices = array.new_float(0)
float golden = na
if not na(swingHigh) and not na(swingLow)
    up = highBar > lowBar
    for lv in levels
        array.push(prices, up ? swingHigh - (swingHigh - swingLow) * lv : swingLow + (swingHigh - swingLow) * lv)
    golden := array.get(prices, 4)
var line[] ls = array.new_line(0)
var label[] lbs = array.new_label(0)
if barstate.islast and array.size(prices) > 0
    while array.size(ls) > 0
        oldLine = array.pop(ls)
        line.delete(oldLine)
    while array.size(lbs) > 0
        oldLabel = array.pop(lbs)
        label.delete(oldLabel)
    from = math.min(highBar, lowBar)
    for i = 0 to array.size(prices) - 1
        y = array.get(prices, i)
        array.push(ls, line.new(from, y, bar_index, y, extend=extend.right, color=color.gray))
        array.push(lbs, label.new(bar_index, y, str.tostring(array.get(levels, i) * 100, "#.#") + "%", style=label.style_label_left, color=color.gray, textcolor=color.white, size=size.small))
plot(swingHigh, "Swing high", color=color.new(color.red, 60), style=plot.style_stepline)
plot(swingLow, "Swing low", color=color.new(color.green, 60), style=plot.style_stepline)
plot(golden, "61.8% level", color=color.orange)
recipes.headline: Runs on the chart and in alerts, with 3 notes

recipes.title: Trendlines through the last two swing highs and lows
recipes.shows: the last two confirmed pivots of each kind are kept in `var`; each side's line is kept in an ARRAY, deleted and made again when a new pivot arrives, and extended to the right; where each line stands on the current bar is plotted, so a break of it can be alerted on
recipes.source:
//@version=5
indicator("Auto Trendlines", overlay=true)
left = input.int(10, "Pivot bars left", minval=1)
right = input.int(10, "Pivot bars right", minval=1)
ph = ta.pivothigh(high, left, right)
pl = ta.pivotlow(low, left, right)
var float h1 = na
var int h1x = na
var float h2 = na
var int h2x = na
var float l1 = na
var int l1x = na
var float l2 = na
var int l2x = na
var line[] resistance = array.new_line(0)
var line[] support = array.new_line(0)
if not na(ph)
    h1 := h2
    h1x := h2x
    h2 := ph
    h2x := bar_index - right
    if not na(h1)
        while array.size(resistance) > 0
            oldLine = array.pop(resistance)
            line.delete(oldLine)
        array.push(resistance, line.new(h1x, h1, h2x, h2, extend=extend.right, color=color.red, width=2))
if not na(pl)
    l1 := l2
    l1x := l2x
    l2 := pl
    l2x := bar_index - right
    if not na(l1)
        while array.size(support) > 0
            oldLine = array.pop(support)
            line.delete(oldLine)
        array.push(support, line.new(l1x, l1, l2x, l2, extend=extend.right, color=color.green, width=2))
resNow = not na(h1) ? h2 + (h2 - h1) / (h2x - h1x) * (bar_index - h2x) : na
supNow = not na(l1) ? l2 + (l2 - l1) / (l2x - l1x) * (bar_index - l2x) : na
plot(resNow, "Resistance line here", display=display.data_window)
plot(supNow, "Support line here", display=display.data_window)
alertcondition(ta.crossover(close, resNow), "Break above the trendline", "Price closed above the resistance trendline")
alertcondition(ta.crossunder(close, supNow), "Break below the trendline", "Price closed below the support trendline")
